name: io.github.chrischall/gogcli-mcp-docs
description: Extended Google Docs for Claude via gogcli — auth + full Docs and comments support

environmentVariables.name: GOG_ACCOUNT
environmentVariables.description: Email address of the Google account to use (matches gogcli auth)

environmentVariables.name: GOG_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Override path to the gogcli binary (auto-discovered otherwise)

environmentVariables.name: DISPLAY_TZ
environmentVariables.description: zone for *Display fields and for interpreting naive gog values; defaults to America/New_York

environmentVariables.name: GOG_READONLY
environmentVariables.description: block all mutating gog API requests (injects gog's --readonly); set to 0/false/no/off (or unset) to allow writes

environmentVariables.name: GOG_TIMEZONE
environmentVariables.description: zone gog formats naive dates in; unset, runner.ts hands gog DISPLAY_TZ so the two cannot diverge
